payload.summary: release-browser-matrix fails on every main run with 13 Firefox/WebKit failures - 5 Firefox tolerance artefacts and 8 WebKit, six of them phone chrome on Safari engine and so likely real iPhone bugs - and it is not in PR required so it never blocks a merge
payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-20 (read from the GitHub job logs of the latest main release-browser-matrix run; still no local browser run, provisioning fails here as described below). THE COUNT IS 13, NOT 15: Chromium green in ~8 min; Firefox 700 passed / 5 failed in ~28 min; WebKit 696 passed / 8 failed in ~40 min. THE 2026-09-06 CONCLUSION IS HALF WRONG AND THE CORRECTION IS THE POINT OF THIS UPDATE. The Firefox half is tolerance work as recorded — one failure is provably a measurement artefact, Expected >= 12 / Received 11.999954223632812, a sub-pixel rounding difference and nothing more. THE WEBKIT HALF IS NOT. Six of the eight WebKit failures are phone scroll, header, footer and composer behaviour. WebKit is Safari engine, so on an iPhone those are candidate real user-visible bugs, not engine-geometry tolerance, and must be read as a bug report rather than assertion-loosening work. ORDER: fix the five Firefox tolerances first because they are cheap and provably artefacts, then treat the six WebKit phone-chrome failures as a defect investigation, and do that before the tablet row #6GR6B8 because the two are plausibly the same root cause. QUARANTINING IS STILL THE WRONG ANSWER, and more so now: quarantining a phone-chrome failure on Safari engine would hide a defect, not a flake. tests/flake-ledger.json is for REPRODUCED flakes, requires @quarantine in the test title, and expires every entry within 31 days — and it is currently empty by design. NOT FIXED 2026-09-18. WHY IT WAS NOT DONE: the failures are only visible by running Firefox and WebKit, and browser provisioning fails in this environment — scripts/setup-claude-cloud.sh browsers returns 403, no allowlist entry for cdn.playwright.dev. A substitute Chromium exists at /opt/pw-browsers and playwright.config.ts honours PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH, so Chromium work is possible here; the other two engines are not. Sizing this needs a machine that can run all three. Note also that this is the one thing keeping main red, so it will be the first failure the new red-main reporting (#T82ND3) raises. Historical note only: an earlier 2026-09-06 write-up used a 15-failure count and treated the whole set as deterministic geometry differences to loosen; that count and that blanket remedy are superseded by this update and must not be reapplied.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep - GitHub job logs for the latest main release-browser-matrix run; supersedes the 2026-09-06 count and diagnosis
